name: empty
why: Degenerate input.

name: plain
why: No special characters -- must pass through untouched.

name: backslash_single
why: The leading rule re.sub(r'\\([^\\]?)') consumes the char after the backslash.

name: backslash_command
why: A LaTeX-looking command must be neutralized.

name: backslash_double
why: Two backslashes: the [^\\] class means the first rule does not pair them.

name: underscore
why: -> \textunderscore with a trailing space.

name: ampersand
why: -> \& ; would otherwise be a tabular column break.

name: pipe
why: -> $|$ (math mode, not an escape).

name: greater_than
why: -> $\Rightarrow$ -- an ARROW, not a literal '>'. Asymmetric with '<' and almost certainly deliberate: cue sheets write 'A > B' to mean 'A leads to B'.

name: percent
why: -> \% ; would otherwise comment out the rest of the row.

name: zwsp
why: U+200B -> \hspace{0pt}. This rule runs LAST, so the braces it introduces are not themselves escaped. Commit 2278d0d.

name: tilde_not_escaped
why: '~' is a LaTeX non-breaking space and is NOT escaped. Latent rendering bug, frozen as-is.

name: caret_not_escaped
why: '^' is superscript in math mode and is NOT escaped.

name: brackets_not_escaped
why: '[' and ']' are NOT escaped.

name: quote_not_escaped
why: '"' is NOT escaped.

name: backtick_not_escaped
why: '`' is NOT escaped.

name: backslash_then_amp
why: '\&' exercises rule order: backslash first, then '&'.

name: all_specials
why: The kitchen sink, matching latex_tests.py:97.

name: real_street_zwsp
why: Verbatim from route 47438923: RWGPS joins street names with a zero-width space.

name: real_amp_street
why: Verbatim shape from route 47438923.
